cards.name: Raiding Parties

cards.value: absorbs 7 a player (14 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 2-4 troops a country at 5 (10-20) + 3 sway (12) = 22-32, about 27; 3.1-4.6, about 3.9 a compute

troops a base is short of its cap is a guess until a read

cards.name: Declaration of War
cards.text: In each country, 3 troops land on factories (else cities); sway 3 toward Discord. Ongoing: each round, the front with the most corp troops fights twice.

effects.why: each round the war step runs twice on the front with the most corp troops (a second round of cancelling and factory strikes): live even when every round is a war round

cards.value: absorbs 18 a player (36 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 3 troops and their strikes now (about 30) + 3 sway now (12) + a second war step on one front (about 12) a round for 1-3 rounds (12-36) = 54-78, about 66; 3.0-4.3, about 3.7 a compute (the second war step is one front table-wide, so it thins at 2+ countries)
cards.check: the military superproject: only fills rounds 7-10, when every round is already a war round, so the second war step is what bites; game-shaping, not a loss: a war seat on that front holds it, and draining 36 a player stops it; one extra step a round, no loop
flags: new op extra_war (ongoing form; front field: the one with the most corp troops, ties unsettled)
an ongoing project acting in the war step: today ongoing projects act only in the build step

cards.name: Station Coup
cards.text: Each board: create 1 adversary ambassador on each of the 2 lowest-numbered research stations. Then in each country, players choose a research station that is not the adversary's; it flips to the adversary, but a player's holds unless 2 adversary ambassadors and no player ambassador are on it (those 2 return to the supply as it flips). If it holds, 1 adversary ambassador lands on it (or cancels a player ambassador there).
cards.value: absorbs 9 a player (18 to drain); harm (a player's share + shared a country): 0 + 2 adversary ambassadors (10; each cancels a player ambassador there and blocks the station's output while it stands) + a corrupted station (20) = 30 a country; 3.3 a compute
